dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: Festival Utsava is near, very happy. Worried about Vana, not happy. Ararycan wants to go back...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Festival Utsava...

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: #Hello, Nara {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: #Thinking about Nara {NICKNAME} singing, makes Ararycan very happy.

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: #Even the biggest, hardest Vamadha will spin in happiness at Nara {NICKNAME}'s songs.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You don't look all that happy...

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: There is no bad guy that wish to make Vana sick, here in Vanarana.

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: If the forest's illness is cured, it must be the same as Vanarana.

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: Festival Utsava is fun, but Ararycan still wants to return, and keep the bad guys away from the forest.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: #Goodbye, and enjoy Festival Utsava, Nara {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon, Ararycan's friends. Seeing friends in Vanarana, happy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the forest...

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: No bad guys, no illness of the forest.

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: Then Ararycan will stay here in Vanarana, with many Aranara instead of strange Nara.

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: #Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Jazari...

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: Nara Jazari is also a strange Nara, screaming loud like he is ill. But Ararycan doesn't think he is bad.

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: He could be Ararycan's friend, only if he sees Ararycan.

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: #Please be good friends with Jazari, Nara {NICKNAME}, Ararycan hopes so.

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: #Also, Ararycan hopes Nara {NICKNAME} won't be scared by the screams of Nara Jazari.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: See you, friends of Ararycan. The forest will look after you.

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: #Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon. Later, Ararycan will return to the bad dirty stuff, and see if anything bad happens.

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: #Ararycan is a good friend to Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon, forever!
